latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release—provides rapid, operator-focused ecommerce KPI insight briefs from pasted data and business questions.

- Converts rough ecommerce metric notes and business questions into actionable markdown briefs.
- Identifies metric alignment, detects anomalies, and generates prioritized next actions for founders, operators, and analysts.
- Handles fragmented inputs without relying on live BI connectors, APIs, or SQL access.
- Surfaces metric definition ambiguities and highlights evidence gaps in provided data.
- Ensures outputs are concise, practical, and executive-ready.
